param.name: in_features
param.dialogReference: Features to evaluate for proximity. Example: reported safety issues, addresses, or assets.

param.name: input_where_clause
param.dialogReference: Optional SQL expression used to filter input features before analysis. Example: country = 'Saudi Arabia'.

param.name: proximity_features
param.dialogReference: Reference features used to find nearby input features. Example: schools, evacuation routes, inspection areas, or a selected point.

param.name: proximity_where_clause
param.dialogReference: Optional SQL expression used to filter proximity features before analysis. Example: country = 'Saudi Arabia'.

param.name: search_distance
param.dialogReference: Geodesic distance used for the selection. Example: 500 Meters or 2 Miles.

param.name: out_features
param.dialogReference: Feature class containing input features within the search distance. Example: C:\data\analysis.gdb\issues_near_schools.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Selects features that are within a user-specified geodesic distance of user-supplied reference features.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: Use this tool when the features to evaluate and the reference features must be chosen at run time. Optional SQL where clauses can filter either layer before analysis. For example, find Saudi Arabian oil and gas fields within 200 Kilometers of ACLED events where country = 'Saudi Arabia'.
